description: Find out why 700,000+ users love ChartExpo Diagrams since 2019. Transform your complex survey and sentiment data into clear, actionable insights with the Diverging Stack Bar Chart by ChartExpo for Microsoft Excel. Perfect for displaying Likert scale data, customer satisfaction scores, and market research findings, this add-in allows you to compare positive and negative responses centered around a clear baseline point without touching a single line of complex code. Key Features & Capabilities: Instant Visualization: Turn raw Likert scale tables (Strongly Disagree, Disagree, Agree, Strongly Agree) into interactive diverging stacked bar charts with just a few clicks. Flexible Data Creation: Generate charts directly from your Excel selection, build them manually, or test using pre-built sample datasets. Customizable Properties: Easily adjust titles, headers, axis scale distribution (%), color palettes, and legend labels to match your corporate branding. High-Quality Exporting: Export publication-ready charts instantly to seamlessly embed into report decks, presentations, and dashboards. Embedded Guidance: Includes built-in video tutorials right inside the add-in pane for quick onboarding. Who Benefits From This Chart?
